title: [Solved] Problem with suspend/resume state on laptop
body: I installed Arch Linux XFCE on my laptop and it enters suspend mode successfully. However, sometimes when I try to wake it up, it just shows a black screen and I have to perform a hard reboot by holding down the power button. No key combination can bring the screen back to life. The worst part is that it only happens sometimes, making it hard to diagnose the root cause. Before this, I had Manjaro XFCE on the same laptop and didn't experience this issue, so I guess it is related to my configuration.
